meta.title: HTTP Method Tester - S-Jiffy
meta.description: HTTP request method and property reference with search filtering
desc: HTTP request method and property reference with search filtering
ui.8: Applies a partial modification to a resource. Unlike PUT, it only applies incremental changes.
ui.9: Establishes a tunnel connection to the target server. Used for HTTPS proxying.
ui.10: Echoes the request received by the server. Used for debugging and diagnostics.
ui.11: Queries the HTTP methods supported by the target resource. Used for CORS preflight requests.
ui.13: Replaces the target resource with the request body. Creates the resource if it does not exist. Multiple calls produce the same result.
ui.14: Submits data to the specified resource. Used to create resources or trigger actions; each request may produce a different result.
ui.15: Similar to GET but returns only response headers, not the response body. Used to check if a resource exists or fetch metadata.
ui.16: Requests the specified resource. Used to fetch data without changing server state.
